body: NSE SHK / BSE 539450. FY26 revenue Rs 2,368 cr (Fragrance 90%, Flavours 10%); promoters Vaze family 54.87% (Sep-2026; 8.3% of promoter shares pledged); chairman Ramesh Vaze died 15-Sep-2026; CEO Kedar Vaze; Group CFO Jagdish Agarwal (Dec-2025). Plants: Mulund (to be vacated), Vashivali (fire 23-Apr-2024, rebuilt), Vanavate (greenfield, Q4 FY27), Mahad, Vapi, Indonesia, Almere NL, Italy. CRISIL AA-/Negative (28-Sep-2026). Auditor BSR from FY27 (Deloitte before). Live deep dive #7 (2026-11-25).
title: S H Kelkar and Company Ltd (Keva) - fragrance & flavour compounder, India + Europe
